summary: Iteration 8: Verified the 5 new enhancements (Daily Targets, Performance targets/talk-time, Live Status Board, CSV exports, Telecaller worklog + call duration). 14/14 new backend tests pass; frontend flows verified for admin (Live Board, Performance Export CSV, Target-vs-Achieved bars, Talk column, Timeline Export button, Users dialog target inputs) and telecaller (worklog strip on dashboard, Live Board hidden + /live-status redirect).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2101 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (auth, users, leads, calls, reports, exports) before adding more features.

GET /api/calls/smartflo-webhook is still exposed as both GET and POST via api_route; GET may still mutate DB. Recommend restricting the mutating path to POST only (previously flagged in iteration 7, unresolved).

LiveStatusBoard triggers a synchronous /api/reports/live-status per interval. For each telecaller it does 3 sequential Mongo queries (call_attempts sort, count, count). At 15s cadence with N telecallers, this scales as N*3 queries every 15s — consider a single aggregation pipeline.
days_in_range walks day-by-day; O(days). Fine for typical windows but could be O(1) using a simple divmod on IST-midnight timestamps.

build_member_performance returns target_calls = daily_call_target * days_in_range without adjusting for weekends/holidays — worth calling out in UX copy that the target is a flat calendar-day multiplier.
test_credentials: Used admin (admin@crm.com / admin123) plus QA leader/caller from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted one TEST target user via /api/users to verify target persistence and negative-value clamping; no permanent data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_enhancements.py alongside existing test_performance.py. Frontend live board first render can look empty for ~1s while /reports/live-status returns — wait ~3-5s after landing. Existing week-trend 7-bucket issue from iter 7 may still be unresolved; not re-tested here (out of scope).
